This manual gathers the main package documentation in one place.

## Outputs

- `docdesigner::pdf` creates a designed PDF document.
- `docdesigner::html` creates plain body HTML for WordPress or another CMS.

## Start

```r
docdesigner::designer_use(template = "pdf")
docdesigner::designer_use(template = "html")
```

## Styles

Use `docdesigner::designer_styles()` to inspect built-in PDF styles. Use `docdesigner::designer_gallery()` to write a local HTML style gallery, or `docdesigner::designer_specimens()` to render a specimen PDF of every style.

A style is a `format.yml` file of design tokens. Scaffold one with `docdesigner::designer_new_style()`, check it with `docdesigner::designer_validate_style()`, and see `docdesigner::designer_tokens()` for the full token vocabulary. The *Creating a style* article covers the workflow and the principles of a good style.

## Update Local Assets

Most projects use bundled package assets. Projects with local editable copies can refresh them:

```r
docdesigner::designer_update_templates()
```

## Reviewing a Draft

The `review` style prints a manuscript to read and mark up by hand: a 3in
writing margin, line and paragraph numbers, a map of the argument from the
headings, margin flags, citation keys, and changebars against an earlier
version.

```yaml
output:
  docdesigner::pdf:
    style: review
    changes_since: v1.0          # a git tag, commit, or earlier copy; default: latest tag
    markup:
      line_numbers: 0            # turn one feature off for this printout
```

In the text, `[[TODO: words]]`, `[[CITE]]`, `[[WEAK]]`, `[[CUT]]`, `[[CHECK]]`
and `[[FIX]]` print as margin tags. Write headings as claims: a heading of
fewer than four words is flagged `LABEL?`. `warning: auto` prints a stamped
"Review draft" line with the git version and date.

## Diagnostics

```r
docdesigner::designer_check()
```
